The terminal session flows directly between phone and Mac and is not stored on cmux servers. The unreleased d421b4b docs source names cmux Pro instead of Founder's Edition.

evidence.title: cmux pricing
evidence.locator: Plan cards; comparison table; FAQ
evidence.finding: Free $0 (open-source macOS terminal, CLI agents with your own keys). One rendering of the page also lists Plus $15/mo (1 saved VM including paused machines, 2-8 vCPU, 4-16 GiB RAM, 16-128 GiB disk, no monthly hour cap). Pro $50/mo or $480/yr (up to 5 Cloud VMs sharing 20 vCPU/40 GB; the cmux iOS app and email support); Max $200/mo or $1,920/yr (5 VMs sharing 80 vCPU/160 GB; the iOS app); Team $60/user/mo (5 VMs per paid seat); Enterprise custom (self-hosted Cloud, SSO and SAML, audit logs, SOC 2 and an SLA). The comparison counts "Saved Cloud VMs, including paused machines". FAQ: the iOS app pairs with the Mac over the built-in cmux iroh network; Free accounts do not include Cloud VMs. "Already paid? Connect Founder's Edition".

evidence.title: cmux LICENSE at release v0.65.2.2

evidence.title: cmux Cloud machine actions in the pricing FAQ
evidence.locator: FAQ: What are Cloud VMs?
evidence.finding: The FAQ describes agents cloning repositories, running commands and opening pull requests on Cloud machines independently of the Mac. It does not name a particular pull-request command. This is a vendor documentation statement, not an installed-product demonstration.

changes.summary: Apply the actual ADE-145 changes-requested dispositions to paid-from, usage-based and container. Their original candidate values and researcher remain in the source, while public output is unknown. Self-hosting remains a candidate for independent recheck after corrected OWN-02. No positive acceptance is inferred.

paid-from.rationale: Lowest public paid plan is Plus at USD 15/month, listed on the live pricing page (2026-11-22) and set in plans.ts behind a Plus-plan flag; one rendering of the page omits Plus, where the lowest is Pro at USD 50/month.

pricing-model:usage-based.rationale: The complete plan list charges flat monthly capacity and seat fees, and the deployed machines docs state there is no metering and no overage billing. Agent-provider usage is separate.

isolation:container.rationale: The Cloud security page explicitly says a machine "is not a container on a shared kernel"; no container option is documented. Cloud scope.

self-hosting.rationale: The core cmux macOS terminal is an open-source download that runs locally on the user's Mac. Production BUSL server components and optional Cloud are excluded.
